name: The Bard
palette: Warm palette of velvet purple, deep wine red and candlelight gold, with glowing golden musical notes.
character: THE BARD: a charismatic, theatrical young man in a velvet purple doublet with puffed sleeves, a feathered purple cap and a short wine-red cape, carrying a battered wooden three-string lute; glowing golden musical notes swirl in the air around him.
icon_subject: the Bard's face under his feathered cap, grinning, front view
portrait: full portrait of the Bard striking a heroic pose on a tavern table, lute raised, notes swirling
banner: The Bard playing his lute at the foot of a dark spire, golden music notes rising up its walls

overrides.strike_bard: Close-up of a hand in a purple velvet sleeve entering from the lower left edge, gripping the neck of a battered wooden three-string lute and swinging it like a club diagonally up to the right; a small burst of golden music notes and wood splinters at the point of impact. Background: crimson fading to deep violet with darker angular streaks.
